description:
Amplitude is the leading AI analytics platform, helping over 5,200 customers—including Atlassian, Burger King, NBCUniversal, and Square—build better products and digital experiences. With powerful AI Agents embedded across our platform, teams can analyze, test, and optimize user experiences faster than ever. Ranked #1 across multiple categories in G2’s Winter 2026 Report, Amplitude is the best-in-class solution for product, data, and marketing teams. Learn more at amplitude.com.

As an organization, we deliver for our customers by living our values. We operate from a place of humility, take ownership of problems and successes, approach challenges with a growth mindset, and put our customers at the center of everything we do.

About The Role & Team

Amplitude’s Americas Field Marketing team drives regional growth through marketing strategies that generate pipeline, accelerate opportunities, and strengthen customer relationships. As the Director, Americas Field Marketing, you will lead the evolution of field marketing from event-centric to pipeline-obsessed, building a strategy and team accountable for measurable pipeline and revenue impact across the Americas. You’ll partner closely with Sales leadership to identify growth opportunities, prioritize investments, and use data to continuously improve regional performance.

This is a leadership role for someone who can set a clear direction, develop a high-performing team, and stay close to the work. You’ll bring together field events, executive experiences, account-based programs, and partner activations to engage prospects and customers throughout the buyer journey. You’ll use performance data to understand which programs create qualified opportunities, improve conversion, and help deals progress, then apply those insights to strengthen regional results.

 

As a Director, Americas Field Marketing, you will:

  • Own the Americas regional marketing strategy and pipeline goals: Build and lead an integrated plan that supports Enterprise and Commercial sales priorities. Establish clear pipeline targets with Sales leadership and translate regional goals, territory needs, and market insights into focused marketing investments.

  • Lead and develop the Field Marketing team: Set direction, establish accountability, and coach regional marketers to become strategic partners to their Sales teams. Balance team capacity and coverage while creating space for creativity, experimentation, and professional growth.

  • Partner with Sales leadership on regional growth: Align with Americas Sales leaders on territory and account priorities, pipeline needs, and opportunities for expansion. Partner with SDRs and Revenue Operations on timely follow-up and clear handoffs that turn program engagement into qualified sales conversations.

  • Build integrated programs that combine regional relevance with scale: Guide the strategy and execution of first-party events, executive experiences, third-party sponsorships, webinars, and account-based initiatives. Partner across Demand Generation, Partner Marketing, Product Marketing, and Customer Success to connect regional programs with broader campaigns and build repeatable approaches across territories.

  • Use data to improve performance and guide investment: Own the regional marketing budget and evaluate programs through pipeline contribution, conversion rates, opportunity progression, and ROI. Establish regular performance reviews, test new approaches, and use findings to refine the program mix, reallocate spending, and communicate business impact to leadership.

You'll be a great addition to the team if you have:

  • You bring a business-owner mindset, connecting marketing decisions to regional growth priorities and making thoughtful choices about where to invest.

  • You build trusted relationships with Sales leaders and can influence priorities, challenge assumptions, and create alignment around a shared plan.

  • You enjoy developing marketers, giving clear feedback, and helping your team grow in both strategic judgment and execution.

  • You’re curious about what drives results and comfortable digging into data, questioning assumptions, and changing course when the evidence points somewhere new.

  • You’re comfortable navigating ambiguity and bring enough structure to help a distributed team stay focused as priorities evolve.

At a minimum, you need to have:

  • 8+ years of B2B marketing experience, including substantial experience in field or regional marketing supporting Enterprise and Commercial sales organizations, preferably within SaaS.

  • 3+ years of people management experience, with demonstrated success leading and developing field or regional marketing teams.

  • A track record of owning marketing strategy across multiple regions or territories, with direct accountability for pipeline goals and measurable contributions to revenue.

  • Experience partnering directly with senior Sales leaders, managing marketing budgets, and building integrated programs across events, executive engagement, and account-based marketing.

  • Strong working knowledge of marketing automation, CRM, and reporting platforms such as Marketo and Salesforce, including experience analyzing funnel performance and using attribution insights to inform decisions.

  • Ability to travel approximately 25–35% for regional events, customer engagements, and team collaboration.

Our values:

At Amplitude, our values guide how we show up for one another and for our customers:

  • Humility: We operate from a place of empathy and openness, seeking to understand many points of view.

  • Ownership: We take the initiative to solve problems that drive our shared company success.

  • Growth Mindset: We’re tenacious in the face of challenges and seek feedback in order to grow ourselves and others.

  • Customer Centricity: We put the customer at the center of everything we do and are deeply committed to their success.

We care about the well-being of our team: We offer competitive pay and benefits packages that reflect our commitment to the health and well-being of our Ampliteers.

Some of our benefit programs include:

  • Excellent ​M​edical, ​D​ental and ​V​ision insurance coverages, with 100% employer-paid premiums for employee Medical, ​Dental,​ ​​​​​​​​Vision on select plans

  • 401(k) retirement plan with an employer match of up to 1% of your eligible pay each pay period up to $2,000 annually

  • Flexible time off, ​p​aid holidays, and more

  • Generous stipends to spend on what matters most to you, whether that’s wellness (monthly), commuter transit/parking (monthly), learning and development (quarterly), new hire home office equipment, and much more

  • Excellent Parental benefits including​:​ 12 weeks of Paid Parental Leave, Carrot Fertility Benefits/Adoption/Surrogacy support, Back-up Child Care support

  • Mental health and wellness benefits including no cost employee access to Modern Health coaching & therapy sessions

  • Employee Stock Purchase Program​ (ESPP)

Other fun facts about Amplitude:

  • Our customers love us! They've said we're the #1 product analytics solution for 23 quarters in a row on G2.

  • We care a lot about product innovation. We've made significant investments in talent and infrastructure to build the most powerful AI analytics platform on the market.

  • We invest in our people. We offer mentorship programs, management training, and wellness initiatives.

  • We give back to our communities. We give every Ampliteer a charitable giving grant and paid volunteer time off.

  • We were founded in 2012, went public via a direct listing in September 2021, and are now trading under the ticker $AMPL.

  • We’re a global and fast-growing team! We have employees around the world and offices in San Francisco (HQ), New York, Vancouver, Amsterdam, London, Paris, Singapore, and Tokyo.

  • Our mascot is Data Monster, who loves to chow down on numbers, charts, and graphs. Nom nom.

By applying for this job, you acknowledge that Amplitude processes your personal data in accordance with the Amplitude Applicant Privacy Notice.
